labels.route_b_s: DERIVED (no tail-ON route B has finished): TIMING_V003 E 16,322 s and U 24,027 s (the LAUNCH_ORDER route-B segments); low 4.0 h ASSUMED

labels.w_rb: DERIVED 1.5 (LAUNCH_ORDER fluid P; MEASURED reference stage 0.8-1.0 is lower)
labels.ra_steady_gb: MEASURED max iterating footprint outside transfer windows, K_big-128 runs
labels.spike_gb: MEASURED largest K_big-128 peak footprint (watch, fast sampler, live sampler) minus ra_steady_gb
labels.spike window: ASSUMED 30-90 s after iteration_prepared (MEASURED single 30-45 s samples)
labels.vf_gb_per_iter: DERIVED u4 (32 x 51,200 x 136 B) beyond the 6 measured iterations
labels.rb_gb: DERIVED model 4.095 GiB (route B not measured)

direct_batches_chosen_max_active.rule: the largest max_active (<= the gate route-A cap, <= n) whose simulated peak total footprint is <= 120 GB in the expected and the 32-iteration (high) rows: the packet's memory check (memory_pressure) is blind, so max_active is its only memory lever; the low rows combine D5 cycle lengths with C4T footprints and are not used
